{{Quote|Where were the Coruscant Guards when the Seppie killers invaded the capital?|Tho-Masfran Ciss|<ref name="The Coruscant Holo Net: Chancellor Safe">[[Star Wars Comic 7.4|''Star Wars'' Comic 7.4]]</ref>}}
'''Tho-Masfran Ciss''' was an individual who worked for ''[[The Coruscant Holo Net]]'' as the [[Senior Coruscant Correspondent]] around [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] wrote an article on the foiled [[Plot to assassinate Chancellor Palpatine|assassination attempt]] on [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and the subsequent promotion of [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] to the rank of [[Junior Representative/Legends|Junior Representative]] for [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In that article, Ciss blamed the élite [[Senate Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] for letting five assassins move around freely around the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]].
